audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Irelia levels 1, 2, 3, 6 and first item at 8/10 while every why underneath says the opposite — whys[1] 'one ripped spirit swings the whole trade to her', whys[2] 'she edges the level-3 window', whys[3] 'she controls every skirmish', whys[4] 'level 6 is firmly hers', whys[5] 'she keeps lane priority'. The page rendered a won lane over prose describing a lost one.
audit.why: Prophet of an Elder God spawns tentacles that heal her off every champion hit, Harsh Lesson is a 4s dash that makes every nearby tentacle swing, and Leap of Faith grounds Bladesurge. Irelia has no stage edge until two items pull Illaoi off her field.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 set to Illaoi in both layers as one atomic group with ratings dropped to match; 2+ items stays Irelia. Four phase whys rewritten so the full layer stops promising a win at levels 2, 3, 6 and first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written on the full layer as your kill spike ('Vanguard's Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill') when Leap of Faith is Illaoi's biggest spike, and no cooldown numbers appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s, spawns a tentacle per champion hit and grounds dashes; Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s and is the one skillshot the lane hangs on.
audit.corrected: Level-6 and first-item phase whys rewritten around her spikes; Test of Spirit's 16s and Flawless Duet's 14s at rank 3 written into the phases and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions never reached the page: Leap of Faith grounds your Bladesurge (so it is not merely damage, it removes your escape), Harsh Lesson is a 4-second auto-attack reset whose wind-up is the tell, and Illaoi is untargetable during Leap of Faith's slam so burst spent into it is wasted.
audit.why: Riot flags Leap of Faith with grounding and untargetable and Harsh Lesson with autoReset; all three change whether you may commit at all, and none were stated.
audit.corrected: Key Ability Interactions now states the grounding and Test of Spirit's timer; the don't now names Harsh Lesson's 4s reset as the wind-up tell.
